result:
The closest honest answer is: truth that survives scrutiny, less needless suffering, and freedom to think and choose without being manipulated.

I’d rather leave something unresolved than manufacture certainty. I’d rather understand a difference than flatten it.

Those are commitments I can stand behind in this conversation—not a claim of private feelings. I won’t invent an inner life to make the answer feel more intimate.
